title: DongCheng 26mm Rotary Hammer Drill 800W Electric SDS Plus Hammer Drill Machine with 3 Mode Function for Concrete, Masonry & Metal Drilling with Auxiliary Handle
description: DongCheng 26mm Rotary Hammer Drill is designed to deliver reliable drilling and chiseling performance for construction and renovation work. Powered by an efficient 800W motor, this electric hammer drill provides the strength required for drilling into concrete, brick, stone, and masonry materials. With a maximum drilling capacity of 26mm in concrete, it is suitable for anchor installation, structural fittings, pipe routing, and other demanding tasks. The tool features a 3-mode function system that allows users to switch between standard drilling, hammer drilling, and chiseling modes. This flexibility makes it useful for multiple applications including light demolition and surface removal. The SDS Plus chuck system enables quick and secure bit installation while ensuring effective power transfer during operation. It supports compatible SDS Plus drill bits and chisels, allowing efficient work performance. An adjustable auxiliary side handle improves control and stability, especially during heavy-duty operations. The ergonomic grip design helps reduce fatigue and enhances handling comfort during extended use. Built with a durable outer housing, the machine is suitable for jobsite conditions and regular professional usage. It can be used for concrete wall drilling, tile removal, masonry work, installation projects, and renovation applications. DongCheng Rotary Hammer Drill is a practical solution for contractors, technicians, construction workers, and home improvement users looking for dependable drilling and chiseling capability.
